run_random_agent: run a random agent in DeepMind Lab environment with configurable frame count and resolution
create_random_agent: create a RandomAgent instance initialized with an environment action spec for random action selection
run_agent_step: run a single random action step from the RandomAgent returning a numpy action array
run_lab_environment: run a DeepMind Lab environment with RGB interleaved observations and custom width and height
run_cli_agent: run the random agent CLI with custom level script, frame count, width, and height arguments
